SL-Banner info — delivery cutoff for the week, --sl-type-meta, --sl-space-8 below

design_system_gaps.need: Long-form editorial layout for producer stories — flowing multi-paragraph text with pull quotes and inline photography
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: SL-Card is a bounded unit with a single image slot and one heading; a full producer narrative has to be faked as a stack of cards, which breaks reading flow and offers no in-body media.

design_system_gaps.need: Seasonal availability calendar — an at-a-glance month-by-month strip showing when a product or category is in season
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: SL-Table carries the data but not the scannable calendar form; SL-DS has no temporal or timeline component, so seasonality stays text-only.

design_system_gaps.need: Share composition — a preview of the shareable card or link generated for a producer or an order before it is sent
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: SL-Modal sheet is a blocking surface for a single decision, not a compose-and-preview surface; no component defines the layout of the shared artifact itself.

design_system_gaps.need: Sequential image gallery for producer and product photography
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: SL-Card poster has one full-bleed slot and SL-DS forbids hover animation with no defined swipe-gallery pattern, so multiple photos cannot be browsed in sequence.
